_comment: Benchmark floors for the verification loop. `pnpm verify` fails when the engine's PIG test-split scores drop below `engine`, when its lint errors per 1000 notes rise above `lint.errorsPer1000Max`, or when a gated run skips a piece. Raise the floor when a milestone improves the numbers; never lower it without a dated note in docs/PROGRESS.md. All numbers are percent, macro-averaged over the test pieces. 2026-10-14: `engine`, `textbook` and `lint` are the M2 rule-based floors (Parncutt + Jacobs + Balliauw rules, hand-position term, textbook templates, literature-default weights, profile large), first set from the m2-rules scorecard (macro gen 59.74, high 66.02, soft 80.28, rec 70.05). 2026-10-14 (M2 review fixes: held-note loop that keeps one side of each conflict, doubled-finger cost for chords of more than five notes, hop weight 10 with 2 points for a hop within a fourth at any tempo, chordBeyondPractical 30, lint L05 a law only on keys held together): raised from the m2-rules-fixed scorecard on 42c24fc plus the uncommitted fix tree (macro gen 60.91, high 66.84, soft 81.65, rec 71.46 over 30 test pieces, 0 skipped) minus 0.5 and rounded down to one decimal. 2026-10-14 (M2 hardening, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-14-m2-hardening.md: every pair of a chord priced and the chord law infinite where a slice has a legal configuration, notated holds beyond reach released, melodic beyondPractical waived after a rest or a release and on thumb crossings within a fourth, chromatic runs templated; lint checks every held pair): `engine` raised from the m2-hardened scorecard on 4dbf87b plus the uncommitted hardening tree (macro gen 61.60, high 67.59, soft 82.38, rec 72.26 over 30 test pieces, 0 skipped) minus 0.5 and rounded down to one decimal; `textbook` raised; `lint` re-based on the stricter lint (see its note). Still 0.5 below nakamura_chmm on gen: the verification spec's gen gate (the best runnable baseline, 62.1) is not met by the rules alone; see docs/experiments.md and benchmarks/history.md. 2026-10-14 (M2 hardening re-review fixes, label m2-hardened-fixed: a key held under a later note is a law at any distance, priced like a chord partner by the decoder for the two nearest notes, by a law-domain pass (arc consistency) and the held-note loop beyond; solver and lint walk the same holds (reach.ts forEachHold); a chord with no legal configuration breaks the fewest pairs; the doubled finger of a slice of more than five notes is the named rule doubledFinger): `engine` raised from the m2-hardened-fixed scorecard on 4dbf87b plus the uncommitted tree (macro gen 61.89, high 67.93, soft 82.62, rec 72.56 over 30 test pieces, 0 skipped) minus 0.5 and rounded down to one decimal; `textbook` unchanged (same measurement); `lint.errorsPer1000Max` lowered from 12.43 to 3.82, the new measurement rounded up, below the 8.32 it had before the hardening re-based it (see its note). Still 0.2 below nakamura_chmm on gen (62.1).

textbook.note: Fractions, not percent: textbook oracle (benchmarks/textbook, 672 entries) note accuracy, measured minus 0.01 and rounded down to two decimals. noteAccuracy, scaleNoteAccuracy and quarter are at quarter = 120 (IOI 0.5 s, the evaluateTextbook default); sixteenths at qpm 480 (IOI 0.125 s); R and L are each hand's entries alone, which guard the left-hand mirror. packages/engine/src/eval/textbook.test.ts reads these values and enforces them in the unit step. 2026-10-14 m2-rules: quarter note 0.527, scale 0.552 (exact 29 of 672). 2026-10-14 m2-rules-fixed: quarter note 0.8422, scale 0.9143, arpeggio 0.7334, chromatic 0.6283, right hand 0.8731, left hand 0.8112 (exact 410 of 672: scales 330 of 432, arpeggios 80 of 192, chromatic 0 of 48); sixteenths identical, since a hop within a fourth now costs the same at any tempo. 2026-10-14 m2-hardened: quarter note 0.8802, scale 0.9143, arpeggio 0.7737, chromatic 1.0000, right hand 0.9227, left hand 0.8377 (exact 486 of 672: scales 330 of 432, arpeggios 108 of 192, chromatic 48 of 48; right hand 257 of 336, left hand 229 of 336, left-hand arpeggios 46 of 96 the weakest group at note accuracy 0.6505); sixteenths identical. 2026-10-14 m2-hardened-fixed: unchanged at both tempos (exact 486 of 672, note accuracy 0.8802); the oracle's melodies never hold a key under a later note, so the held-pair law does not touch them.

lint.note: Lint errors per 1000 notes of the solver's output on the 30 test pieces; bench gates it. History: 2026-10-14 m2-rules 22.11 (226 errors, mostly L05 leaps between notes that do not overlap, which lint then called a law); m2-rules-fixed 8.313 (85 errors: L05 74, of them 68 chord spans, and L03 11; that note blamed the chord spans on PIG legato overlaps, the M2 review found the cause in the solver, which priced chord spans only between neighbouring notes of a slice). m2-hardened 12.42 (127 errors) under a stricter lint that checks every key still held against every later note it sounds with: 0 chord-span L05 where a legal configuration exists, but 98 held-pair L05, because the solver had no span law between a held key and a note other than its sequence neighbour; the gate was re-based to 12.43 for that run, which the re-review rejected (it hid avoidable solver errors). 2026-10-14 m2-hardened-fixed (gate 3.82, the measurement rounded up, under the same stricter lint): 39 errors in 10,225 notes, 3.81 per 1000; 0 relaxed hands; 7 slices with no legal configuration. The solver now treats a held key like a chord partner: the decoder charges the held-note penalty for a span beyond practical (or the same finger) between a note and a key held one or two steps back, a law-domain pass (arc consistency over every held pair and chord pair) forbids from the start the fingers no law-keeping fingering can use, and the held-note loop mends the rest. Breakdown: L05 22 = 14 chord spans, all inside the 7 infeasible slices, and 8 held pairs (98 before); L03 17 (15 before), 11 of them on a note of a chord, where more keys sound than the hand has fingers within reach. The experts' own fingerings of the test pieces (every annotator, 4 to 6 per piece, 50,014 notes) score 8.00 errors per 1000 notes under this lint (L03 4.36, L05 3.12, L01 0.48, L02 0.04; 6.68 under the m2-rules-fixed lint, 47.4 under the m2-rules lint).

hands.note: Hand separation (digitus2 evalhands): macro accuracy in percent on the PIG test split, first annotation of each piece, channel = truth. Set by M6 Task 9 to the measured value minus 1.0. Set 2026-10-14 by M6 Task 9 from 92.05 (commit 86ea924, measured on the uncommitted M6 Tasks 3-6 tree over it; label m6-hands; macro 92.0499 minus 1.0, rounded down to one decimal; note-weighted 91.89; shipped tables from the library and the Mutopia train half, no PIG data).

nakamura_chmm.note: Nakamura's released combined HMM on the official PIG test split (30 pieces), measured by the baselines agent on 2026-10-13 with the Python scorer that matches the official C++ evaluator to 5e-7

human_agreement_ceiling.note: inter-annotator general match rate reported by Nakamura et al. 2020; re-measured in docs/research/datasets.md
